name: Vaibhav Parasa
subtitle: Data Scientist & ML Engineer · Agentic AI & LLM Systems
bio: I'm an AI/ML engineer working at the intersection of data engineering and agentic AI — designing LLM-driven systems, production ML pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps them reliable at scale. My background spans agent architectures built on LangChain, ETL/ELT pipelines across Databricks and Snowflake, and predictive modeling for forecasting and demand planning. I hold an M.S. in Data Science from Florida State University and hold ServiceNow Admin & Developer certifications.
